context.validated_for: OpenAI-compatible tool calls, long-context marker retrieval, and sustained streamed generation

caveats: Full-context concurrency is one sequence. This is a high-context single-request profile, not multi-user throughput evidence.
The 49,125-token marker-retrieval check passed once; the three sustained runs established speed repeatability at 118,660 prompt tokens and 512 generated tokens.
NVFP4 weights and FP8 KV are not quality-equivalent to the separate Qwen3.8 Q6_K/f16-KV llama.cpp preset.
The explicit 2.50 GB KV allocation per GPU is required with the persistent vLLM compile cache; automatic sizing over-allocated KV and could OOM on a real long prefill.
The experimental 1,000 tok/s prefill target was not reached. The stable retained result is 952.50 tok/s median prefill and 67.29 tok/s median decode.
